title: feat(plugin-email): email template names resolve by (package, name) through the shared resolver
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9B9qYj7GTyDGfaMgXwXx7rZ)_

Part of #31677

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Narrowing: D3 (a) declared by the card, measured 0 here (a send names no package, so no reader in this PR has a caller package; first-party package-caller reads wired: 0, so the closure-outside sub-case of #31527 comment 6728487836 measures 0, sibling-in-the-same-artifact included). Beside it, ruled on #31677 (Q1 letter A, 6729831159): an email template name two packages held from before phase 1 (the cold-boot seal's warn list) is refused like every other two-holder name instead of rendering from the first-listed package. First-party count: 0 (HotCRM 6961ab1, ADR-0150's census).

Part of epic #31527 (ADR-0150 child E5), the email template half. Connectors landed in #31725, webhooks in #31744. This half waited on R2 #31733 (merged as 36a87008), which stopped the resolver from counting a dependent's added locale (#28802) as a second holder of its base's name (Q2). **Remainder on #31677:** `connector_action`'s `connectorConfig.connectorId` resolving from the calling flow's package (seat answer 6728849524, Q3); the flow's package context now exists with E1 #31738, and that wiring lands as the card's last PR, which closes it.

Card thread `domain:server#3` · `os-steve` · `session_01ADHkmR4astMzES5UkW47jW`; claim 6728454873, file-surface amendments 6728498905 and 6728849524 (Q4: `plugin-email/vitest.config.ts`).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：发邮件和渲染模板时，按名字取哪个模板，先问 R 的共享解析器 `resolvePackageScopedName`（无包调用方）：先环境自建项，再全环境唯一的包持有者（内置模板排在应用模板之后，依赖包追加的语言不算第二个持有者），否则发送失败并列出全部候选；解析通过后按语言选条目的逻辑不变。
- 为什么改：ADR-0150 把邮件模板改为按（软件包, 名称）寻址；以前两个包同名时静默用列表里第一个包的模板。
- 风险与回滚：只影响阶段一之前就已经有两个包同名的部署（启动时已有「Bare-name conflict at boot」警告）。按维护者裁决 A，这类发送改为 409，日志里点名两个包；第一方计数 0。其余名字的发送结果不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/template-loader.ts` 的 `readBundle` 开头和 `EmailTemplateAmbiguousError`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-email exec vitest run src/template-loader.test.ts -t "ADR-0150"`，预期 2 条通过：应用模板与内置模板同名时照常解析；两个包同名时发送被拒，抛 409 并点名两个包。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。本卡还剩 connector_action 的 connectorId 按调用 flow 的软件包解析，作为最后一个 PR。

## What changes

`createRegistryEmailTemplateLoader`'s `readBundle` (behind `EmailService.sendTemplate` / `renderTemplate`) now asks the ONE package-scoped resolver (`resolvePackageScopedName`, `@objectstack/objectql`) which template a name means before it picks a locale. `SendTemplateInput` names no package, so the loader asks as a caller with **no package** (ADR-0150 D3): the environment's own item, else the unique package holder (the overridable baseline `com.objectstack.service.email` ranks below a package holder, D3 (b); a dependent's bundle addition is no holder, R2), else a refusal naming every candidate.

| Reader on `main`, by symbol | Pick today | Caller package | After this PR |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `createRegistryEmailTemplateLoader` `readBundle` | first non-built-in item per `(name, locale)` slot | none (`SendTemplateInput` carries no package) | the name is resolved first; a refusal fails the send with `EmailTemplateAmbiguousError` (409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, `candidates`); any other answer leaves the layered list's pick unchanged |

When the loader is handed a registry without the resolver's slice (a test double carrying only `listItems`), it keeps the listed order: `template-locale-resolution.test.ts` "resolves the same member on repeat calls when two packages declare one slot" stays green on that ground. A real host always passes the ObjectQL `SchemaRegistry`, which carries the slice.

`@objectstack/objectql` moves from `devDependencies` to `dependencies` (claim amendment 6728498905). No cycle: objectql's workspace closure (deps, devDeps and peers) does not contain plugin-email.

## ADR-0150's four readings

- **(a) phase-1 one-holder tests stay green.** Untouched by this PR; the four `bare-name-one-holder*` dogfood files run in the targeted subset and the full run below.
- **(b) bare-name behaviour unchanged for every name with one holder.** `template-loader.test.ts` pins the app-beside-built-in case on a real `SchemaRegistry`; `email-template-dependent-unshipped-locale-read.dogfood.test.ts` (a dependent's added `fr-FR` under the base's name) is green on this head, where at `da3bc28e`, before R2, it was 3 red. The one change is the ruled narrowing above. No URL, MCP or SDK surface moves.
- **(c) no migration.** Nothing stored is read or written differently.
- **(d)** `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`; no ADR-0087 entry.

## Tests

`plugin-email/src/template-loader.test.ts`, new describe "the name resolves by (package, name) (ADR-0150 D3)": an app's template beside the built-in renders the app's wording as before; two packages holding the name refuse the send with the 409 naming both, for any locale. `vitest.config.ts` stops re-exporting the shared preset and spells its one setting (`disableConsoleIntercept: true`, which `check-console-intercept-disarm` reads from the file's source) beside `env: { OS_REGISTRY_LOG: 'warn' }` (the suite builds a real `SchemaRegistry`; `check:registry-log-declared`). No existing test changed.

Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete`, on this head, restored to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty after; the suite imports `src`, so no `dist` leg): the refusal throw removed → 1 failed, "two package holders: the send is refused with the 409 conflict naming both — never the first listed": `AssertionError: expected undefined to be an instance of EmailTemplateAmbiguousError`.

## Verification

Head 375152d8 (on `main` 630a0baa, after R2 #31733):

- `@objectstack/plugin-email` test exit 0 (50 files, 831 tests), typecheck exit 0, under `os-verify-lock` (one `&&` command, VERDICT command-exit 0). Root `eslint --no-inline-config packages/plugins/plugin-email`: exit 0 (no `lint` script).
- Targeted dogfood after `turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/dogfood^...'` (70/70): 19 files on the three types (including `email-template-dependent-unshipped-locale-read`), 98 tests passed.
- Full dogfood run (owed for the declared narrowing), `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock at 375152d8: VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 440 passed / 3 skipped (443), Tests 3654 passed / 41 skipped (3695).
- Derived gates at 375152d8: 79 derived, all 79 `exit 0`; `--ran`: "79 derived, 79 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN" (a derived zero). The first pass, at 48ab8da9, had `check-console-intercept-disarm` red on the preset-merging config; the second commit is that fix.
- `test:repo` not run locally (CI's `Test Core`); this diff touches no repo-project test.
